recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍（A）骨小樑間的髓腔被瀰漫性小細胞浸潤取代、脂肪幾乎消失；高倍（B）為小淋巴球與漿細胞樣細胞混合，箭頭處可見核內淡粉紅色、圓形的 Dutcher 小體（核內免疫球蛋白偽包涵體），是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的重要線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse, near-total replacement of intertrabecular space (low power, A)
Infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with clock-face chromatin
Dutcher bodies: pale eosinophilic round intranuclear pseudo-inclusions (arrows, B)
Mild nuclear variation without large transformed cells or sheets of blasts
Scattered eosinophilic cytoplasm of plasma cells; few residual hematopoietic elements
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a small-cell infiltrate (A). At high power (B), the infiltrate is composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, with readily identified Dutcher bodies appearing as round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear pseudo-inclusions. Large transformed cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, favoring lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, pending immunophenotyping and MYD88 L265P testing.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL can show identical plasmacytic differentiation and Dutcher bodies; separation relies on clinical sites (splenic/nodal/extranodal), paratrabecular vs sinusoidal pattern and absence of MYD88 L265P in most MZL.
Myeloma consists of clonal plasma cells alone (CD19-/CD20-, often CD56+) without a clonal CD20+ small B-cell component.
CLL/SLL infiltrates are CD5+/CD23+ small lymphocytes with proliferation centers and lack prominent plasmacytic differentiation.
MCL shows monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive without plasma cells or Dutcher bodies.
